summary: fix(game-goat): ITAD credential ops stay in the selected home and never cross homes; accept abbreviated ITAD titles without matching unrelated games
reason: Greptile P1s and follow-ups on the ITAD credential path: RAWAG set-token/logout dropped or stranded the sibling ITAD key; a permission-refused file was overwritten; with --config the write/removal targeted the default home; a cross-home credential fallback could copy the default home's ITAD key into a selected home; GAME_GOAT_CONFIG homes were bypassed by ITAD ops; and the non-exact title guard both rejected abbreviations and accepted unrelated substring matches. Config now remembers the credentials file it read, exposes CredentialsFilePath, reads the ITAD key only from that same home, and all credential writes/removals plus ITAD auth/price/browser paths are path-aware; the title guard accepts the query as a prefix of the candidate's article-stripped core title.
